# Three.js runtime files

These files are the pinned Three.js `r128` browser build and examples used by
FOUR ZERO TWO. They are stored locally so the game can start without reaching
third-party CDNs.

- Package: `three@0.128.0`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128>
- License: [THREE-LICENSE.txt](THREE-LICENSE.txt)

The example files are loaded in dependency order by `four-zero-two-v79.html`.
